newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq, hit by sell-offs, closes lower.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq, hit by sell-offs, closes lower.

text.p: Significant sell-offs in several stocks, including high tech giant Intel Corp, resulted in the Nasdaq market taking a beating on Friday, one day after it hit a new record closing high.
The Nasdaq Composite fell 8.56 points, or 0.67 percent, at 1261.80 by its unofficial close while declines led advances by 2171 to 2080 on volume of about 624 million shares.

Intel, one of the most heavily weighted stocks on Nasdaq, tumbled four to 115-7/8 in what analysts said was profit-taking and a temporary shift by some momentum investors away from the stock towards its smaller rival Advanced Micro Devices. It was the third consecutive lower day for the stock, but analysts said they remained confident about its long-term outlook.

Other big losers included ITI Technologies Inc, which fell 18-3/16 to 11-15/16. Dain Bosworth said it cut its rating on the stock to hold from buy after the company said its largest customer would cut back on purchase orders in the first quarter.
Health Management Systems Inc shares fell 7-5/8 to 14-1/2 after the company issued a profit warning, the latest in a string from health information services companies.
